about: The notice board of device_panels.json's London touchscreen as the notice board provider composes it at noon on 2026-09-25 from the store's values in tfl_notices.json and met_office.json (no bank holiday is within a month), under v1:notice-board:<device id>: each notice worded, short (title and summary) and long (text), with the provider's own text as its detail, worst first and the planned works last. The titles and summaries of TfL's are a model's shortening of TfL's reason. Its id is a member of v1:sub:board. The store contract's canonical example (countdown-api's countdown_api/fixtures), which every consumer's tests read: change it there.
